fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The tournament calendar table on `/` and `/tournaments/` had jQuery tablesorter applied to it, which made it sortable in a nonsensical way (tournament dates/names don't sort usefully via the default tablesorter logic).

## What changed

In `shared_web/static/js/pd.js`, the `noTablesorter` selector was extended from `"table.live"` to `"table.live, table.calendar"`. The tournament calendar template (`decksite/templates/tournamentcalendar.mustache`) uses `<table class="calendar">`, so this single-character change excludes it from tablesorter initialization.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- There are no Python-level unit tests for this JS behaviour; the change is a one-line JS selector update with no logic to unit-test.

Fixes #6770
